dog.description_text:
💕 JAZZY aka JASMINE
🐶 Female | 3 months old | Lab Mix | 13 lbs.
Happy, smart, playful and apparently part fish. 😂💦 Meet Jazzy!
Jazzy is one of those puppies who seems to just fit right in. Her foster describes her as a very happy, well-adjusted little girl who has settled beautifully into life in her foster home. ❤️
She loves playing with the other dogs, but she's also perfectly happy entertaining herself. Give this girl a toy and she's good to go
dog.name: Jazzy
